channel.title: Thock Report
channel.description: Fresh takes for mechanical keyboard builders and enthusiasts.

item.title: The New Tactile Switch Revamp
item.description: A fresh tactile switch line lands with a smoother stem and refined spring, aiming to balance clicky feel and quiet operation.

item.title: Vintage PBT Set Takes the Spotlight
item.description: A retro‑inspired PBT set resurfaces, offering deep‑dye colors and a matte texture that resists shine after months of use.

item.title: Low‑Profile Build: Space‑Saving Performance
item.description: A compact low‑profile keyboard shows how to maximize desk real‑estate without sacrificing typing comfort.

item.title: Hot‑Swap PCB Group Buy Gains Momentum
item.description: A community‑driven hot‑swap PCB for 75% layouts hits its funding goal, promising easy switch swaps for future upgrades.

item.title: Lubing Trends: What’s Hot in 2024
item.description: Lubing techniques evolve, with new greases and tools shaping smoother keystrokes across tactile and linear switches.

item.title: Artisan Keycaps Market: Supply vs Demand
item.description: The artisan keycap scene sees a surge in limited runs, prompting collectors to weigh rarity against cost.
